description.content:
Request example:
```
curl -X GET "https://api-sandbox.postnl.nl/shipment/v2_2/calculate/date/delivery?ShippingDate=29-05-2022+14%3A00%3A00&ShippingDuration=1&CutOffTime=17%3A00%3A00&PostalCode=2132WT&CountryCode=NL&City=Hoofddorp&Street=Siriusdreef&HouseNumber=42&HouseNrExt=A" \
 -H "Accept: application/json" \
 -H "apikey: APIKEY-HERE" 
```

query.description: (Required) Date/time of preparing the shipment for sending. Format: dd-MM-yyyy hh:mm:ss

(Required) The duration it takes for the shipment to be delivered to PostNL in days. A value of 1 means that the parcel will be delivered to PostNL on the same day as the date specified in ShippingDate. A value of 2 means the parcel will arrive at PostNL a day later etc.
(Required) Default cutoff time
(Required) Zipcode of the destination address
(Required) The ISO2 destination country code
The ISO2 origin country code
City of the destination address
The street name of the destination address.
The house number of the destination address
House number extension of the delivery address
(Required) The delivery options that you want to take into account when calculating the expected delivery date
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for mondays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on mondays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for tuesdays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on tuesdays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for wednesdays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on wednesdays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for thursdays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on thursdays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for fridays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on fridays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for saturdays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on saturdays
Overrides default cutoff time specified in the CutOffTime parameter for sundays specifically
Specifies if you are available to ship to PostNL on sundays
